findings.evidence: The section-wide attribute is at line 25; action and character lemmas already characterize the unbundled representations at lines 41, 60, 71, and 79.
findings.fix: Remove `@[expose]` and keep these bodies opaque; add any missing downstream-facing lemmas instead.
findings.issue: `@[expose] public section` exposes the bodies of `stdRep`, `stdFDRep`, `stdDualRep`, and `stdDualFDRep`, although their intended behavior should be available through lemmas.

findings.evidence: The only bundled declarations are `FDRep.of` definitions at lines 55–56 and 85–86; all existing action/character lemmas concern `stdRep` or `stdDualRep`, while Mathlib exposes `FDRep.of_ρ'` specifically as the bundled action API.
findings.fix: Add `[simp]` lemmas such as `(stdFDRep k n).ρ = stdRep k n` and the corresponding trace character formula, with parallel lemmas for `stdDualFDRep`.
findings.issue: `stdFDRep` and `stdDualFDRep` have no public simp lemmas identifying their `.ρ` or `FDRep.character`, so categorical consumers must unfold their bodies; the same omission occurs at line 85.

summary: The bundled representations lack their characteristic API, while the file exposes every definition body to compensate.
